data.criterion: pass when the analysis can be reproduced
pass when claims identify their source
pass when the response answers the request
pass when results support a decision
pass when the response uses the run language consistently

design.criterion: pass when goal, target player, and player fantasy are stated
pass when the loop is ordered and gives time per loop
pass when every system has inputs, outputs, unlocks/dependencies, and no orphan remains
pass when every currency/resource has named sources and sinks, numeric rates, and a pacing target
pass when at least three risks have impact and mitigation or kill criterion
pass when KPIs have definition, baseline/target, and an event used to measure them
pass when a number reused across sections has one value

plan.criterion: pass when the objective is measurable and has success criteria
pass when milestones are dated, predecessors are shown, and the critical path is named
pass when every workstream has an owner and demand versus capacity per person has no unflagged over-allocation
pass when each risk has an owner, trigger, and mitigation

content.criterion: pass when a named segment and insight are present
content.evidence: audience and insight lines with source

content.criterion: pass when one proposition has no more than three supports with proof
pass when brand voice and the register for the run language are stated
pass when one primary CTA has a destination and measurement method
